shortDescription: Installs and uninstalls Windows Features on Windows Server

options.name: include_management_tools
options.description: Adds the corresponding management tools to the specified feature. Not supported in Windows 2008 R2 and will be ignored.

options.name: include_sub_features
options.description: Adds all subfeatures of the specified feature.

options.name: name
options.description: Names of roles or features to install as a single feature or a comma-separated list of features. To list all available features use the PowerShell command C(Get-WindowsFeature).

options.name: source
options.description: Specify a source to install the feature from. Not supported in Windows 2008 R2 and will be ignored. Can either be C({driveletter}:\sources\sxs) or C(\\{IP}\share\sources\sxs).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the features or roles on the system.
